pipeline.name: daily-social
pipeline.description: Daily social content creation pipeline — discovers published articles and creates professional social posts

parent.title: [{{date}}] Daily social pipeline
description: Create social posts for recently published articles.
This pipeline runs independently of the content pipeline.
Pipeline: Growth Analyst (select + plan) → Copywriter (copy) → Frontend Designer (assets) → Content Manager (drafts)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Social plan: select articles + assign formats
description: ## Select articles for today's social posts

### Step 4 — Check performance data + format rotation
Use `postFormatPerformance` to identify which formats are over/under-represented.
- If last 3 posts were all `image`, the next MUST be `carousel` or `text-only`
- If no `carousel` in last 7 posts, force one carousel this cycle
- If no `video` in last 14 posts, consider a video (max 1/week, cost ~$0.30)
- 4+ clear takeaways or steps → `carousel` (template: key-takeaways or step-by-step)
For each article (1-2 per day), post a comment with:
- Post format (image / carousel / link-only / document / video / text-only)
- Carousel template (if applicable): key-takeaways / stat-highlight / step-by-step
- Hook suggestion (most surprising stat or contrarian take from the article)
If no new articles found in the last 48h, comment 'No new articles to promote — slot stays open for weekly recycle' and set to done.
